Subject: Tethr.ai Dedicated pool sequencing & SLA deconflict

Hi Harrison / Amira —

Congrats again on kickoff. Per our intake call last week I put together a short sequencing checklist to lock down region preference, burst policy guardrails, and the cutover milestones so we can scope the Dedicated GPU pool provision and SOW. I attached the intake-checklist.csv (lightweight) for you to confirm.

Key asks to finalize this week:
- Preferred primary region (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1)
- Expected peak concurrent sessions and token QPS during peak (estimate helps sizing)
- Compliance notes: any stricter retention or network segmentation beyond SOC2 / customer VPC?
- Desired burst window policy (minutes of sustained spike we should tolerate before burst triggers)

Initial proposal from our side (subject to sizing):
- Primary region: us-west-2 (recommended for current latency targets)
- Autoscale baseline: min 2 worker nodes; max 12; scale step +2 nodes, cool-down 90s
- Burst reserve: warm standby of 2 pre-warmed nodes for 10-minute windows; auto-fallback to hosted fleet if capacity constrained

Next steps: tech sync to lock region + network diagram, then we hand SOW to legal for redlines. Are you available for a 30m technical sync Tues/Thurs this week?

Attachments: intake-checklist.csv

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Harrison Lee <harrison@tethr.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amira Khan <amira@tethr.ai>, procurement@tethr.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tethr.ai Dedicated pool sequencing & SLA deconflict

Logan —

Thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers:
- Region: prefer us-west-2 as primary, with eu-west-1 as DR (we have a small EU customer base)
- Peak: we expect ~400 concurrent sessions with spikes to ~1.2k sessions during batch runs. Token QPS during peak workloads ~35k tokens/s (very bursty for 6-8 minutes).
- Compliance: SOC2 is baseline. We will need customer-specific retention rules for a subset of PII-containing conversations (30-day retention on production logs, separate export pipeline).
- Burst window: we'd like a 10-minute burst tolerance; if sustained beyond 15 minutes we want automatic throttling and notification to our ops.

Attached the simplified network-diagram.pdf showing our VPC/subnet peering requirements. Procurement looped in for the SOW timeline — Amira, procurement@, we need the SOW + PO cadence.

Harrison Lee
Head of Platform
Tethr.ai

Thanks Harrison — quick follow-ups from infra side before we schedule cutover windows: 

1) Sizing check: the 35k tokens/s burst for 6-8 minutes maps to ~3.2 p99 latency goal at your current model. We'll propose a 4-shard configuration (A100-class) with continuous batching enabled. Can you confirm tokenization scheme (roughly tokens per message) and the share of long-tail prompts (>1k tokens)?

2) Autoscale + burst behaviour options (choose one):
- Option A: Aggressive scaling — min 2 / max 14, scale step +4 nodes, warm standby 3 nodes (faster reaction, higher cost)
- Option B: Cost-first — min 2 / max 10, scale step +2 nodes, warm standby 1 node, burst throttling after 12 minutes
- Option C: Hybrid — min 2 / max 12, dynamic warm standby based on daily traffic percentiles (recommended)

3) Network: we can peer to your VPC; need a CIDR & gateway for the peering. Per your diagram, there is a private subnet for inference, confirm if there are egress restrictions to S3 for model caches.

4) Cutover cadence: we prefer a 2-week activation sprint: week 1 (provision + connectivity + smoke tests), week 2 (ramp + canary & fallback test). We'll need a tech point on your side for day-of cutover (Slack + 30m stand-by).

Can we lock a 30m tech sync tomorrow 11:00 PST to confirm options?

—Karthik
Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference

Great alignment — thanks all. Quick summary and agreed actions so nothing falls through the cracks:

Decisions made:
- Primary region: us-west-2; DR region eu-west-1
- Autoscale path: Team choses Option C (Hybrid) — min 2 / max 12, dynamic warm standby based on 95th percentile, scale step +2, cool-down 90s
- Burst tolerance: 10-minute soft window; after 15 minutes automated throttling + ops notifications to Tethr (per Harrison request)
- Data retention: Redwood will apply a 30-day retention policy for PII-tagged logs and provide an export hook for your downstream pipeline

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Tethr: confirm tokenization assumptions + % long-tail prompts (Harrison / Amira) — ETA: Tue 12/7
- Redwood infra (Karthik / Neha): provision 4-shard pool in us-west-2, prepare warm-standby orchestration — ETA: provision start 12/8; smoke tests 12/10
- Redwood CS (Logan / Monica): schedule cutover day, create canary script + SLO checklist and share Doc link — ETA: 12/6
- Procurement (Amira / procurement@tethr.ai): SOW review & PO submission; Redwood legal to accept redlines — target DocuSign timeline 12/13

Thanks — looking forward to a low-friction activation.
